claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.grant_speed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Dragon Wings grants a Fly Speed of 60 ft for the duration. ClassFeatureEffect only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. The v4 atom modify_speed exists in the taxonomy but is not wired into ClassFeatureEffect. A new variant is needed to carry speed-kind (fly/walk/swim/climb) and the feet value.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.long_rest_or_spend_resource
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature resets on Long Rest by default, but the player may also restore the use mid-rest by spending 3 Sorcery Points (no action required). This is a two-path reset — Long Rest OR resource expenditure — not expressible by any existing RestResetCadence variant. A new variant carrying the resource kind and point cost is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.
